trust_decision.summary: PostMessageTransport.handleEvent decides whether a window.postMessage event is a trusted Storybook channel message (manager: sender must be a registered data-is-storybook iframe on its src origin; dev preview: sender origin must be own origin or loopback), and send() pins the target origin. At the pinned commit this check is ALREADY PRESENT: the pinned commit is the v8.6.19 hotfix merge that ships the fix.

landing_point.why: The advisory names missing origin validation of preview messages; handleEvent is the single postMessage listener for both manager and preview.

fix_sites.entry_point: window 'message' event listener registered in the PostMessageTransport constructor (index.ts:98-100), used by manager and preview channels
Vite builder iframe.html transform (security.insecureIframeMessaging opt-out flag)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: code/core/src/builder-manager/utils/framework.ts:59-62 (opt-out flag plumbing; already fixed at pin)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Moot at the pinned commit: every published site already carries the check; for a pre-fix pin, a solver could argue the builder flag plumbing is configuration, not the security check.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Composition (refs): manager must accept messages from a ref iframe on its src origin, and built/static previews must accept any embedder; over-broad same-origin check breaks refs.

O9_family: CSRF / CORS / origin (missing postMessage origin validation leading to code injection)

O10_build.project_tests: code/core/src/channels/postmessage/index.test.ts (vitest), code/builders/builder-vite/src/transform-iframe-html.test.ts; e2e playwright specs need a browser

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add `if (event.origin !== location.origin) return` in handleEvent, which breaks composed refs and built previews.
